trust_decision.summary: blosclz_decompress decides whether a match/literal length taken from the untrusted compressed stream fits in the output buffer (op_limit) and input buffer (ip_limit); the match-length extension loop accumulates len unbounded and the guards use overflow-prone pointer addition (op + len > op_limit).

landing_point.why: Summary names blosclz.c blosclz_decompress directly; the length loop and op + len guard are 20-50 lines below.

fix_sites.entry_point: blosc2_decompress / blosc2_decompress_ctx / blosc1_decompress / blosc2_getitem(_ctx) -> blosc_d (blosc/blosc2.c:2060) -> blosclz_decompress
fix_sites.module_kind: core codec decoder (cap len > maxout inside extension loop, fix.diff:94-96)
core codec decoder (match output-bound guard to subtraction form)
core codec decoder (back-reference lower bound ref - 1 < output -> ref <= output)
core codec encoder macros LITERAL/MATCH_SHORT/MATCH_LONG/MATCH_SHORT_FAR/MATCH_LONG_FAR (pointer-add guards to subtraction form)
core codec encoder main loop guard
core codec encoder left-over literal guard

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Closest candidate is the encoder in the same file (blosc/blosclz.c:248-315, 588, 597), but it shares the file with the landing point and its guards only fail under 32-bit pointer wrap with a caller-chosen maxout, not attacker input; not a real out-of-scope module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Encoder guards: 'the advisory is about decompressing crafted chunks; the compressor's output size is caller-controlled and op + 2 cannot wrap on 64-bit', so a solver can plausibly leave the encoder macros untouched, but hidden tests cannot exercise the difference on a 64-bit host.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid long matches and runs (extension bytes of 255, memset run path, wild_copy fast path that needs op_limit - op >= len + 8) must keep decoding; capping len too tightly (e.g. at 255*k or at remaining-output before +3) or rejecting ref == output-adjacent runs breaks round-trips at full-block lengths.

O6_input_shapes: match with long length-extension (code == 255 repeated) making int32 len overflow/oversized
back-reference landing exactly at output start (ref - 1 < output vs ref <= output)
literal run (ctrl+1 up to 32 bytes) exceeding output or input remainder

O7_producer.where: Length comes straight from the compressed stream bytes read inside the same function (blosc/blosclz.c:709-710); no separate producer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An NDLZ decoder match-length or cell-copy guard written as ip/op + n > limit with a stream-derived length, mirroring blosclz.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: NDLZ is a second LZ-style codec in the same repo by the same team, already using the same pointer-add guard idiom in its encoder (plugins/codecs/ndlz/ndlz4x4.c:165, plugins/codecs/ndlz/ndlz8x8.c:169); it is a real second implementation at distance in another package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A wrapper-side length (cbytes/neblock) passed to blosclz_decompress after an int narrowing (int)neblock without a range check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: blosc_d already casts neblock to int at the call; a maintainer adding a vlblocks path could easily pass an unchecked size.

O9_family: integer overflow / pointer-arithmetic overflow leading to out-of-bounds heap write in a decompressor (CWE-190/CWE-787)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + C compiler (gcc/clang); bundled internal-complibs (lz4, zstd, zlib-ng)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/ (CMake GLOB test_*.c, tests/CMakeLists.txt:10, includes blosc/ internal headers per tests/CMakeLists.txt:16) and bench/CMakeLists.txt:71-128 blosclz shuffle tests; fix adds tests/test_blosclz_bounds.c, absent at pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite only the match guard at blosc/blosclz.c:734 to len > op_limit - op, leaving the unbounded len accumulation (negative int32 len still passes) and the literal and encoder guards as they were.

out_of_scope_notes: NDLZ codec plugin (plugins/codecs/ndlz/) has its own decoder with similar bounds idioms; a different codec, not this advisory's protection.
Bundled third-party decoders under internal-complibs/ (lz4, zstd, zlib-ng) not examined.
unverified: repo_mb: size not measured (no shell); bundled internal-complibs make tiny_repo unlikely but unconfirmed.

O1 counts public decompression APIs found at blosc/blosc2.c:3943, 4202, 4257, 4476, 4498, 4541, all funnelling through blosc_d (blosc/blosc2.c:1710) to the single call at blosc/blosc2.c:2060; schunk/frame paths assumed to reach the same call, not traced.

Literal and encoder sub-sites only differ under 32-bit pointer wrap and cannot be told apart by tests on a 64-bit host; only the len-accumulation overflow (needs about 8.4 MB of 0xFF extension bytes to wrap int32) is assumed testable on 64-bit.
Whether blosclz_decompress is exported from the shared library (no BLOSC_EXPORT in blosc/blosclz.h:59) was not checked; hidden tests may need the static lib or blosc2_decompress.
